fact: At COP28 China, through the China Academy of Space, donated a P31 million multi-satellite meteorological transportable ground application system to the Department of Meteorological Services; a memorandum between the two governments was yet to be signed.
system: Multi-satellite meteorological transportable ground application system

fact: The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Botswana among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
